import hashlib, json, pathlib, re, subprocess, sys
source = pathlib.Path('products/services/merchant-feed-variant-qa/google-merchant-products-v1-proto.txt')
base = pathlib.Path('products/services/merchant-v1-group-id-sample/executed-controls')
base.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
report = {'source_sha256': hashlib.sha256(source.read_bytes()).hexdigest(), 'synthetic': True, 'controls': {}}
text = source.read_text(encoding='utf-8')
match = re.search(r'((?:^[ \t]*//[^\n]*\n)+)[ \t]*optional string item_group_id\s*=\s*\d+;', text, re.M)
comment = match.group(1).strip() if match else ''
report['field_comment'] = comment
normalized = ' '.join(line.strip().removeprefix('//').strip() for line in comment.splitlines()).lower()
supported = report['source_sha256'] == '33292e48e4e5ebd4a9146b6f3bda2583f8e8cb69341b9ed789ce8273124e5304' and 'variants' in normalized and ('same product' in normalized or 'single product' in normalized) and ('group' in normalized or 'same' in normalized)
runner = '''import csv
import json
import sys
from collections import defaultdict

with open(sys.argv[1], encoding="utf-8", newline="") as stream:
    rows = csv.DictReader(stream)
    if rows.fieldnames != ["expected_family", "offer_id", "item_group_id"]:
        sys.exit(2)
    groups = defaultdict(set)
    for row in rows:
        family, offer, group = (row[key] for key in rows.fieldnames)
        if None in row or not all(value and value.strip() for value in (family, offer, group)):
            sys.exit(2)
        groups[family].add(group)
    if not groups:
        sys.exit(2)
conflicts = {family: sorted(ids) for family, ids in groups.items() if len(ids) > 1}
print(json.dumps({"conflicting_families": conflicts}, sort_keys=True))
sys.exit(int(bool(conflicts)))
'''
if supported:
    for filename, contents in {'check.py': runner, 'pass.csv': 'expected_family,offer_id,item_group_id\nlinen-shirt,shirt-blue,G1\nlinen-shirt,shirt-white,G1\n', 'fail.csv': 'expected_family,offer_id,item_group_id\nlinen-shirt,shirt-blue,G1\nlinen-shirt,shirt-white,G2\n'}.items():
        (base / filename).write_text(contents, encoding='utf-8')
    for case, code, conflicts in [('pass', 0, {}), ('fail', 1, {'linen-shirt': ['G1', 'G2']})]:
        run = subprocess.run([sys.executable, 'check.py', case + '.csv'], cwd=base, capture_output=True, text=True)
        expected = json.dumps({'conflicting_families': conflicts}, sort_keys=True) + '\n'
        report['controls'][case] = {'exit': run.returncode, 'stdout': run.stdout, 'stderr': run.stderr, 'expected_match': run.returncode == code and run.stdout == expected}
report['status'] = ('CONTROLS_MATCH' if all(c['expected_match'] for c in report['controls'].values()) else 'CONTROL_MISMATCH') if supported else 'SOURCE_REQUIRES_READBACK'
(base / 'result.json').write_text(json.dumps(report, indent=2) + '\n', encoding='utf-8')
if supported:
    import shutil
    shutil.make_archive(str(base / 'sample'), 'zip', base, verbose=False) if False else None
bundle = {name: (base / name).read_text(encoding='utf-8') for name in ('check.py', 'pass.csv', 'fail.csv') if (base / name).exists()}
(base / 'runner-and-fixtures.json').write_text(json.dumps(bundle, indent=2) + '\n', encoding='utf-8')
print((base / 'result.json').read_text(encoding='utf-8'))
